invariants.description: costs and the ATP port balance (exact): J_RNA, J_ribo, J_lipid from their counts; repair; growth
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_RNA, n_mRNA*L_mRNA*c_nt_recycle*np.log(2)/t_half_mRNA/N_A*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_upkeep, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_lipid, 2*A_mem*surface_factor/area_per_lipid*c_lipid*k_lipid/N_A*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_upkeep, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ribo, n_ribo*L_rRNA*c_nt_recycle*k_ribo/N_A*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_upkeep, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(R_rep_phys, repair_level*r_rep_max*D_phys/(K_D + D_phys)*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_rep_rad, repair_level*r_rep_max*D_rad/(K_D + D_rad)*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_rep_ribo, repair_level*r_rep_max*D_ribo/(K_D + D_ribo)*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_rep_energy, repair_level*r_rep_max*D_energy/(K_D + D_energy)*f_ATP_bio*R_reg_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_repair, R_rep_phys + R_rep_rad + R_rep_ribo + R_rep_energy, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_repair, R_repair*C_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ATP_bio, -J_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ADP_bio, J_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: growth is asked in multiples of the resting turnover, throttled and regulated: J_growth = growth_level J_ref throttle R_reg; the daughter costs M_build_bio + M_build_protein; progress = P_growth / M_daughter, glycogen progress = M_glyc_ATP / M_daughter (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(throttle, np.clip((ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(J_growth, growth_level*J_ref*throttle*R_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(M_daughter, M_build_bio + M_build_protein, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(growth_progress, P_growth/M_daughter, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(glycogen_progress, M_glyc_ATP/M_daughter, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)

invariants.description: the daughter receives exactly the growth ATP spent: P(t) - P(0) = int J_growth_used dt (relative 1e-6)
damage balance of each type: D_x(t) - D_x(0) = int (accrual - repair) dt (relative 1e-6), never negative; the total is their sum (exact)
invariants.expr: abs(D_phys[-1] - D_phys[0] - np.trapz(r_dmg_phys + 0*t - R_rep_phys, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(r_dmg_phys + 0*t) + np.abs(R_rep_phys), t) + 1e-15 and np.all(D_phys >= 0) and abs(D_rad[-1] - D_rad[0] - np.trapz(R_dmg_rad - R_rep_rad, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(R_dmg_rad) + np.abs(R_rep_rad), t) + 1e-15 and np.all(D_rad >= 0) and abs(D_ribo[-1] - D_ribo[0] - np.trapz(R_dmg_ribo - R_rep_ribo, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(R_dmg_ribo) + np.abs(R_rep_ribo), t) + 1e-15 and np.all(D_ribo >= 0) and abs(D_energy[-1] - D_energy[0] - np.trapz(R_dmg_energy - R_rep_energy, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(R_dmg_energy) + np.abs(R_rep_energy), t) + 1e-15 and np.all(D_energy >= 0) and np.allclose(D, D_phys + D_rad + D_ribo + D_energy, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: damage accrual (exact): wear, Ca2+ overload and K+ loss for the ribosomes, falling ATP for de-energisation, k_rad dose rate for radiation; the thresholds give exactly 0 above them
invariants.expr: np.allclose(f_Ca_dmg, Cai**n_Ca_dmg/(K_Ca_dmg**n_Ca_dmg + Cai**n_Ca_dmg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(f_K_dmg, np.clip(1 - Ki/K_K_dmg, 0, None)**2, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(f_energy_dmg, np.clip(1 - ATP/ATP_dmg, 0, None)**2, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_dmg_ribo, r_dmg*f_T_dmg + k_Ca_dmg*f_Ca_dmg + k_K_dmg*f_K_dmg, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_dmg_energy, k_energy_dmg*f_energy_dmg, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_dmg_rad, k_rad_dmg*dose_rate, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: regulation (exact): R_reg = prod (1 - reg_on + reg_on f) and J_growth = growth_level*J_ref*throttle R_reg; with every switch off R_reg is exactly 1
invariants.expr: np.allclose(R_reg, (1 - reg_on_ATP + reg_on_ATP*f_ATP_reg)*(1 - reg_on_G6P + reg_on_G6P*f_G6P_reg)*(1 - reg_on_glc + reg_on_glc*f_glc_reg)*(1 - reg_on_H + reg_on_H*f_H_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_growth, growth_level*J_ref*throttle*R_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and (reg_on_ATP or reg_on_G6P or reg_on_glc or reg_on_H or np.all(R_reg == 1.0))

invariants.description: regulation of the upkeep (exact): R_reg_upkeep = prod (1 - reg_on_upkeep + reg_on_upkeep f); 1 with every switch off
invariants.expr: np.allclose(R_reg_upkeep, (1 - reg_on_ATP_upkeep + reg_on_ATP_upkeep*f_ATP_reg)*(1 - reg_on_G6P_upkeep + reg_on_G6P_upkeep*f_G6P_reg)*(1 - reg_on_glc_upkeep + reg_on_glc_upkeep*f_glc_reg)*(1 - reg_on_H_upkeep + reg_on_H_upkeep*f_H_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and (reg_on_ATP_upkeep or reg_on_G6P_upkeep or reg_on_glc_upkeep or reg_on_H_upkeep or np.all(R_reg_upkeep == 1.0))

invariants.description: regulation of repair (exact): R_reg_repair = prod (1 - reg_on_repair + reg_on_repair f); 1 with every switch off
invariants.expr: np.allclose(R_reg_repair, (1 - reg_on_ATP_repair + reg_on_ATP_repair*f_ATP_reg)*(1 - reg_on_G6P_repair + reg_on_G6P_repair*f_G6P_reg)*(1 - reg_on_glc_repair + reg_on_glc_repair*f_glc_reg)*(1 - reg_on_H_repair + reg_on_H_repair*f_H_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and (reg_on_ATP_repair or reg_on_G6P_repair or reg_on_glc_repair or reg_on_H_repair or np.all(R_reg_repair == 1.0))

bc_sweep.rationale: temperatures 0-40 C; repair level and growth over the ranges the game offers; Cai from rest to a dead cell's (~2 mM), Ki from none to rest; an attack removing a lethal load in 17 min; 1 Gy/s, a lethal dose in 5 min
